cues.text: Carribu connects families, drivers, and the school office.
From home, to pickup, and on to the school gates.
Follow recorded trip updates and the latest available bus location.
For families, see linked children and their assigned transport.
Check recorded pickup and drop-off updates, and contact the driver.
For drivers, review assigned trips and the student list.
Record pickups, absences, and drop-offs as the run progresses.
For the school office, manage students, routes, vehicles, and drivers in one workspace.
Review trip progress with the actual Carribu admin dashboard.
Preview new students, updates, and errors before import.
Pilot with staff, then roll out to families.
See how Carribu could fit your school. Request a demo by email.
Scan the code, or use the address on screen.
